title: Bleb Power
description: A standalone mod adapting the FE power connector and wire from Create: Crafts & Additions with new original models and textures
body:
This mod is a shameless copy of the FE energy connectors from [Create: Crafts & Additions](https://modrinth.com/mod/createaddition) by MRH0, with new models and textures. The original mod (and therefore this mod) is licensed under the MIT license.

Adds a single simple FE power transfer block, the Bleb, which can be switched from Pull mode to Push mode with a Create Wrench. Using a Gayble you can connect Blebs together, and power will flow from Pull Blebs to Push Blebs, provided the Pull Blebs are connected to a source of FE power from another mod.
![Two Blebs connected by a Gayble](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d9c61348ff98b9a0e418dbd9585834021cb3df61.png)
